senses.gloss: An organized search for a criminal or enemy.
To send a message or monetary funds to another person through a telecommunications system, formerly predominantly by telegraph.
Lack of decency; the property or degree of being indecent.
Nearest in order, succession, or rank; immediately following (or sometimes preceding) in order.
The time ahead; those moments yet to be experienced.
Succeeding to an office or other position.
Existence.
An area, open to the sky, partially or wholly surrounded by walls or buildings.
The creation of permanent dwellings at sea, especially outside the territory claimed by any national government.
That operates, moves or takes place at less than normal speed.
A freshwater fish, taxonomic name Lota lota, which is similar to the ling and the cusk and spawns in the winter.
Clockwise, particularly when describing a change in direction or orientation.
Having life; living; not dead.
(archaic, outside, heraldry) Right; on the right-hand side. (In heraldry, specifically the bearer's right, which is the viewer's left.)
(political) A person who belongs to the political right.

A programmable electronic device that performs mathematical calculations and logical operations, especially one that can process, store and retrieve large amounts of data very quickly; now especially, a small one for personal or home use employed for manipulating text or graphics, accessing the Internet, or playing games or media.
Any of several aromatic bushy herbs, of the genus Hyssopus, native to Southern Europe and once used medicinally.
An associate in the commission of a crime; a participator in an offense, whether a principal or an accessory.
A bird of prey of genus Pandion that feeds on fish and has white underparts and long, narrow wings each ending in four finger-like extensions.
A result that one is attempting to achieve.
The end for which something is done, is made or exists.
A butt or mark to shoot at, as for practice, or to test the accuracy of a firearm, or the force of a projectile.
The point intended to be hit, or object intended to be attained or affected.
A goal that is striven for.
(literally) A spring that is the source of a river.
capable of displaying only text characters or having a text-based user interface
To identify or point out; to blame for something.
To have as a necessary consequence; to lead to (something) as a consequence.
A retail business selling newspapers, magazines, and stationery; a stationer.
The (layer of) plants that grow in the shade of the canopy of a forest above the forest floor.
Deceased, dead.
To kill, especially as punishment for a capital crime.
The immature young of an eagle; an eagle chick.
A record of a thing or an event stored and available for later use by an organism.
An autobiography; a book describing the personal experiences of an author.
Something old and outdated, possibly kept for sentimental reasons.
A keepsake; an object kept as a reminder of a place or event.
An object given by a person and retained in memory of something or someone; something kept for sentimental or nostalgic reasons.
The act of participating, of taking part in something.
A coming to; the act of acceding and becoming joined.
The collective discipline of study or learning acquired through the scientific method; the sum of knowledge gained from such methods and discipline.
A period of rest from work for the purpose of eating lunch.
An amount of money paid to a worker for a specified quantity of work, usually calculated on an hourly basis and expressed in an amount of money per hour.
A fixed amount of money paid to a worker, usually calculated on a monthly or annual basis, not hourly, as wages. Implies a degree of professionalism and/or autonomy.
A payment for work done; wages, salary, emolument.
A shared record of past transactions in a distributed network, typically used for cryptocurrency.
The condition of being friends.
A feeling of friendship, relatedness or connection between people.
The spirit of goodwill that exists among friends; comradeship.
A close friendship in a group of friends or teammates.
(formal, literary) Friendship; friendliness.
(archaic, or, obsolete, uncountable) Friends and acquaintances.
Not compatible (with another thing); incompatible, discrepant, at odds.
An often domesticated mammal (Mustela putorius furo) rather like a weasel, descended from the European polecat and often trained to hunt burrowing animals.
A person who lives in a forest.
Savages collectively; the world of savages.
Aloof; reserved; unsociable and unfriendly.
A member of a Native American people, formed from the Huron confederacy, that lived in and around Ohio.
A gathering of persons for a purpose; an assembly.
An association or alliance of people for some common purpose.
A legislative body.
All the people engaged in the same business, especially those of the same profession
A group of people associated for a common purpose.
(trademark) An international electronics and media company based in Tokyo, Japan.
A political unit ruled by an emperor or empress.
(by extension, mostly, pejorative) Any organization in the control of a dominant individual.
An act of nuzzling (all verb senses).
(Bible) A writer of a gospel, especially the four New Testament Gospels (Matthew, Mark, Luke, and John), usually capitalized (Evangelist).
A pipe or channel, or system of pipes or channels, used to remove human waste and to provide drainage.
The hygienic disposal or recycling of waste.
A network of sewer pipes that geographically transfers wastewater; a sewer system.
The currency of the United Kingdom, based on the pound sterling; hence, genuine English or British currency, as contrasted with foreign currency.
The disclosure of one's sins to a priest for absolution. In the Roman Catholic Church, it is now also termed the sacrament of reconciliation.
An elongated depression cast between hills or mountains, often with a river flowing through it.
A valley, often in an otherwise hilly area.
A secluded and narrow valley, especially one with a river running through it; a depression between hills; a dale.
A deep narrow valley or gorge in the earth's surface worn by running water.
Without meaning to, in an unintentional manner, not intentionally.
With little enthusiasm or interest.
a small bread roll, often sweetened or spiced
A long-winged vulture, Gypaetus barbatus, found in southern Europe, Africa and India.
An institution or social practice of owning human beings as property, especially for use as forced laborers.
The state of being enslaved or the practice of slavery.

The state of being a slave; slavery; being forced to work for others or do their bidding without one's consent or against one's will, either in perpetuity or for a period of time over which one has little or no control.
The act of enslaving or the state of being a slave; bondage
(literary, or, puristic, otherwise, archaic) A state of bondage, slavery, or subjugation to another person.
Clothes for wearing to bed and sleeping in, usually consisting of a loose-fitting shirt and pants/trousers.
compass point
That which conveys what is announced.
The announcement of a forthcoming marriage (legally required for a church wedding in England and Wales and read on the three Sundays preceding the marriage).
A situation orchestrated to frame someone; a covert effort to place the blame on somebody.
A stage setting; scenery; set; backdrop.
The design of theatrical sets.
To disturb the emotional equilibrium of; to distress; to greatly impact (most often positively).
To dull the senses or capacity to think thereby reducing responsiveness; to stun.
Any of the genus Naja of venomous snakes that can spread their neck ribs into a broad hood when threatened; a true cobra.
An item placed on a stage or set to create a scene or scenario in which actors perform.
Something that belongs to part of another main thing; something additional and subordinate, an attachment.
(grammar) A modifier that is appended or prepended to another word to coin a new word that expresses belonging.
One who plays the drums.
A slapstick performance artist often associated with a circus and usually characterized by bright, oversized clothing, a red nose, face paint, and a brightly colored wig.
One who performs in a silly or ridiculous fashion; a clown or fool.
A grotesque performer or clown, buffoon.
(by extension) A foolish or conceited person; a dandy.

A small long and narrow boat, propelled by one or more people (depending on the size of canoe), using single-bladed paddles. The paddlers face in the direction of travel, in either a seated position, or kneeling on the bottom of the boat. Canoes are open on top, and pointed at both ends.
Sexual activity, usually sexual intercourse unless preceded by a modifier.
Pairing of organisms for copulation.
The head of the government in some German-speaking countries.
The rank or post of a chancellor.
(engineering) penetration of a physical barrier
The pungent aromatic rhizome of a tropical Asian herb, Zingiber officinale, used as a spice and as a stimulant and acarminative.

A usually translucent and somewhat elastic, dense, nonvascular connective tissue found in various forms in the larynx and respiratory tract, in structures such as the external ear, and in the articulating surfaces of joints. It composes most of the skeleton of vertebrate embryos, being replaced by bone during ossification in the higher vertebrates.
Cartilage; now especially: cartilage present, as a tough substance, in meat.
A formal name used in source code to refer to a variable, function, procedure, package, etc. or in an operating system to refer to a process, user, group, etc.
A person from Chile or of Chilean descent.
In favor of.
Disbelief or uncertainty (about something); (countable) a particular instance of such disbelief or uncertainty.
to make the sound of a scream
To utter a sudden and loud cry, as in joy, triumph, exultation or anger, or to attract attention, to animate others, etc.
To cry out suddenly, from some strong emotion.
(intransitive) To utter a loud, sharp, shrill sound or cry, as do some birds and beasts; to scream, as in a sudden fright, in horror or anguish.
Dull; not reflective of light.
Allowing little light to pass through, not translucent or transparent.
A device pulled through the ground in order to break it open into furrows for planting.
A standard by which something is evaluated or measured.
A stone used to verify the quality of gold alloys by rubbing them in order to leave a visible trace.
Greatly praised or lauded, revered, highly respected.
To strengthen, especially by addition or augmentation.
(biblical) The tenth book of the New Testament of the Bible, an epistle to the people of Ephesus which is attributed to Paul the Apostle.
Not in accord with the usual regulations.
An Ethiopian language which is extinct but still used liturgically.
The human intestinal parasite Giardia lamblia.
to cause to have the streaked appearance of marble
To eject something violently (such as lava or water, as from a volcano or geyser).
An interruption to the regular flow or sequence of something.
Willing to comply; submissive; willing to do what someone wants.
Meekly obedient or passive; obsequious.
Willing to comply with the commands, orders, or instructions of those in authority; biddable.

A synthetic, crystalline compound, C₆H₇N₃O, (trademarks Hydra, Hyzyd, Isovit, Laniazid, Nydrazid, Rimifon, Stanozide) used as a bacteriostatic medication in the prevention and treatment of tuberculosis.
present participle and gerund of fuck
Generic intensifier. Fucking; bloody.
Used as an intensifier.
The simultaneous or serial production of heat and electricity from the same source.
Capable of being touched; tangible or palpable.
A member of the phylum Chordata; numerous animals having a notochord at some stage of their development; in vertebrates this develops into the spine.
An unfilled space in something solid; a cavity, natural or artificial.
A hollow in a rock; a cave or cavern.
hole or hollow depression
A place inhabited by a criminal or criminals, a superhero or a supervillain; a refuge, retreat, haven or hideaway.
A fence or barrier consisting of one or more horizontal rails and vertical supports.
(military) A fortification consisting of a wall.
The rail on the side of a staircase that a person's hand holds onto.
A fortification consisting of a breast-high bulwark; a parapet.
To remove the fleece from (a sheep, llama, etc.) by clipping.
(orthography) A short, straight, horizontal diacritical mark (◌̄) placed over a letter, usually to indicate that the pronunciation of a vowel is long. [from 19th c.]
Any of various confections made with almond and egg white, traditionally made in France.
A soft biscuit or cookie prepared with almond or coconut dough.
An ancient Greek city in the NE Peloponnesus on the plain of Argos, inhabited since about 4000 B.C.E.
A province of the Netherlands, with Zwolle as capital city and Enschede the largest city.
The state in which blood glucose levels are above normal but have not reached those of diabetes.
Soft, fluffy immature feathers which grow on young birds. Used as insulating material in duvets, sleeping bags and jackets.
Any of the species of Somateria spp. and Polysticta stelleri or of the seaduck subfamily Merginae, which line their nests with fine down (taken from their own bodies).
A male ant, bee, or wasp, which does not work but can fertilize the queen.
Of, from or relating to Sicily, Italy.
A blue discolouration of the skin due to the circulation of blood low in oxygen.
Officially sanctioned postponement of compulsory military service.

The act of forcing sex upon another person without their consent or against their will; originally coitus forced by a man on a woman, but now generally any sex act forced by any person upon another person, regardless of gender; by extension, any non-consensual sex act forced on or perpetrated by any being.

A military action consisting of a large armed force of one geopolitical entity entering territory controlled by another such entity, generally with the objective of conquering territory or altering the established government.
A pâté baked in such a dish and served cold.
A broad, deep serving dish used for serving soup or stew.
Having two or more equally applicable meanings; capable of double or multiple interpretation.
A glass or plastic vessel or bottle, especially a small tube-shaped bottle used to store medicine, perfume or other chemicals.
A person who sculpts; an artist who produces sculpture.
Without visible stars.
(botany) The leaf of the embryo of a seed-bearing plant; after germination it becomes the first leaves of the seedling.
The quality of being long-lasting, especially of life.
A long, pointed stick used to prod animals.
Someone with schizoid personality disorder.
